Update as of September 24: Timeline of the University's Response

Between August 31 and September 1, ISSO notified all affected students. Given the volume of impacted students we felt it unwise to issue any messages before a weekend, when staff would not be available to organize advising sessions both at ISSO and at the Schools. Any and all visitors to ISSO are given specific attention.
On September 23, the International Student Hardship Fund opened for Fall 2026.
